author: G. K. Chesterton
name: The Resurrection of Rome
desc: Chesterton's book on his visit to Rome in 1929-30, after the Lateran Treaty: the outline of a city, the story of the statues, the pillar of the Lateran, the return of the gods, the return of the Romans and the Holy Island. A traveller's tale and a meditation on the permanence of Rome and the Church.
desc_pt: O livro de Chesterton sobre sua visita a Roma em 1929-30, depois do Tratado de Latrão: o esboço de uma cidade, a história das estátuas, o pilar do Latrão, o retorno dos deuses, o retorno dos romanos e a Ilha Santa. Um relato de viagem e uma meditação sobre a permanência de Roma e da Igreja.
edition: The Resurrection of Rome (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1930), Internet Archive (Digital Library of India scan), OCR full text.
manual: Part I: The Outline of a City
Part II: The Story of the Statues
Part III: The Pillar of the Lateran
Part IV: The Return of the Gods
Part V: The Return of the Romans
srcnote: Six parts and two appendices as printed.
tierEvidence: Chesterton died in 1936 and the book was published in 1930, so it is public domain (in the US since 1 January 2026).
